svg.title: Real-Time Behavioral Authentication System — Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: Six-layer architecture: Capture monitors feed SQLite storage; a feature-extraction, baseline, and GPT-4o mini scoring pipeline analyses behavioural data; FastAPI exposes REST endpoints; a React+Vite dashboard polls every 3 s; the GPT scorer calls OpenAI externally using only z-scores and feature values.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the keystroke monitor capture dwell time and flight time using pynput?')
sendPrompt('What mouse dynamics does the monitor capture and how are they used as behavioural features?')
sendPrompt('How does the zshrc hook and file tail approach capture terminal commands for behavioural analysis?')
sendPrompt('Describe the SQLite WAL-mode schema and thread-safe queue writer design.')
g.text: sessions · keystroke · mouse · shell · features · baseline · alerts

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What are the 13 behavioural features extracted per 10-second window?')
sendPrompt('How does the baseline engine use 3 warmup windows to compute mean, std, and Z-scores?')
sendPrompt('How does GPT-4o mini receive behavioural features and return a structured risk assessment?')
sendPrompt('What does each FastAPI endpoint return in the behavioural authentication system?')
sendPrompt('How is the React + Vite dashboard structured and what does each page show?')
g.text: Sessions · Alerts · Live monitor · Z-score bar charts

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What exactly is sent to the OpenAI API and what structured data is returned?')
